name: Real-time feasibility
description: Solve-time scaling in LSTM hidden size and prediction horizon, against the control period. The timing_critical flag runs these serially after every other experiment has finished; with twenty workers on twenty cores the worst-case latency would measure contention between them. The CSTR sweep includes the physics NMPC under the hidden_size = -1 sentinel, the convention the analysis notebook uses. The two-tank benchmark has no physics-MPC counterpart, so its grid is neural-only, and it starts at 32: the 8- and 16-unit checkpoints fail every solve from this scenario's empty-tank start, and 32/64/128 is the set the CTS analysis notebook covers.
